hero.sub: Private, slow-made journeys across India and beyond — planned by people who have walked the route first.

why.heading:
We travel the route
before we sell it.
why.lede: Every itinerary here has been walked, eaten and slept through by someone on our team. We know which room at the haveli catches the morning light, which pass closes early in October, and which driver will stop when you ask him to.

pillars.title: Planned by hand
pillars.text: No third-party inventory dumped into a page. Every stay, driver and permit is one we have used.

pillars.title: One person, start to finish
pillars.text: The same planner answers you before you book, while you travel, and after you are home.

pillars.title: Small caravans
pillars.text: Private departures, or group trips capped small enough that everyone eats at one table.

reviews.text: We asked to move a night to Jaisalmer four days before flying. It was done by evening, with the new hotel already confirmed.
I have booked a lot of trips to India. This is the first time nobody tried to take me to a carpet shop.
Twelve strangers on day one. We still send each other photographs from that ridge.

legal.cancellation: Full refund minus bank charges up to 45 days before departure. 50% up to 21 days. No refund inside 14 days. Non-refundable components are noted on each package.
